text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
…Jeez,
even in your dreams you're still
performing?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two,
it seems that dessert is being served… hmm?
As expected,
it seems as though Ticket has run out of
energy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll go and get us 3 servings of cake. 
Taishin, keep an eye on Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah… Jeez,
you're like a little kid, 
going full force until the very end,
then running 
out of energy and falling asleep.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Uwah!? Wai- Hey…!! 
Ah, jeez… she's not waking up…!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ohh? The young ones sighed in sync… 
Still on cloud nine or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes… To get to sing together with you,
Teio-san, and 
Rudolf-san…! It still doesn't feel real!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, it was so much fun! 
Again… I'd love to be able to experience
that again…!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Woa- They… They're too pure! 
Although I guess I knew that already.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But yeah… You can experience that as many
times as you want. As 
long as you continue to run with all you've
got… doncha think?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? Nature is going to sing with Satono
and the others again!? 
No fair! No fair!! I wanna sing too!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I agree… After all, we've been 
giving it our all as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're right!! 
Then I guess it's our time to strike!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uwah!?
What's with you girls all of a sudden…? 
Wa-Wai-Wait! That hurts! Gueh…!
